name: mini-hbut-identity-platform
description: Mini-HBUT OIDC / App Approval 身份平台（源码随主仓库版本管理，Vercel CLI 手动部署）

scripts.check: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm -r run test && pnpm -r run build
scripts.check:core: pnpm --filter @mini-hbut/identity-core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mini-hbut/identity-core run test && pnpm --filter @mini-hbut/identity-core run build
scripts.check:web: pnpm --filter @mini-hbut/identity-web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @mini-hbut/identity-web run test && pnpm --filter @mini-hbut/identity-web run build
